messages:
maria (Marketing): Ok team — launching the 3‑part tutorial series next week. Primary goals: community traction, dev sign-ups, and a short benchmark narrative for the blog. Draft plan below.

sam (DevRel): timeline?

maria (Marketing): timeline: Wed 2026-03-25 - teaser tweet + community post; Mon 2026-03-30 - Part 1 tutorial (quickstart + code); Wed 2026-04-01 - benchmark blog (topline numbers + methodology); Thu 2026-04-02 - webinar signup opens.

lee (Content): I'll draft Part 1 tutorial and webinar landing copy. Sharing doc now: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-link. Can we reuse two benchmark charts from the experiment run? :+1:

juan (DevRel): I'll spin up the reference repo and starter template. ETA 3 days. Will include a tiny docker-compose and a one‑file example for quick local runs.

tess (Analytics): Tracking: add UTMs: utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=tutorial_series&utm_content=part1 and GTM event 'tutorial_signup'. Also add a webinar tag 'trial_interest' for registrants.

maria (Marketing): Routing: inbound leads -> tag 'tutorial_series' then route: webinar_registrants with company_size>50 OR self-identified 'enterprise' -> SDR queue. Others -> nurture drip. Everyone ok?

sam (DevRel): For messaging iteration: we'll A/B test 3 webinar subject lines. Keep main claim 'Predictable LLM inference at lower cost' and an alternate 'Scale LLM apps with confident latency SLOs'.

lee (Content): I'll write 3 variants for the email and 2 for the landing headline. Pasting copy options in the doc. Need Jason to sign off on benchmark wording.

jason (Product): Approved to use 95th‑percentile latency and per‑token cost ranges from the new harness. Please avoid publishing raw traces or internal cluster IDs.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled teaser tweet set for 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC.

maria (Marketing): Action items (Fri check-in 16:00 PT): lee - copy + emails; juan - repo + demo; sam - webinar ops + rehearsal; tess - tracking + dashboards; jason - final numbers. We'll run a dry run Wed. :rocket:

sam (DevRel): noted, will run rehearsal Wed 09:00 PT and share slides.

lee (Content): ACK

juan (DevRel): ACK

tess (Analytics): ACK
